notes.title: Version 1.1 New Weapon, The Rusty Sidearm!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44172062/ecb4b0f3bf30ba7673dc5ccf716ab9ce1b89f6a9.png[/img]

+ Added a new gun called Rusty Sidearm.
+ Every weapon has individual weight.
+ Added a Godot splash screen.
+ Updated drop area to be more intuitive.
+ UI hand rotating item animation.
+ Changed Shotgun location.
+ Steam achievements will display on unlock.
+ Rifle does more damage.
+ Changed Inventory background.
